method: Public connected probes in PE; target ASN determined in memory from v4/v6; reported probe geometry overlaid with INEI 2023 district polygons. Only aggregate counts persisted; no IDs, coordinates, or district codes/names.
limits: Probe inventory is not outage evidence or representative customer telemetry.
A district with one volunteer probe does not establish robust area coverage.
RIPE Atlas obscures probe location; assignments near polygon edges are flagged uncertain.
Existing public measurements for target ASNs in the prior inventory yielded zero latest results; this probe census does not create or schedule a measurement.
